title: closure-operator
description: A family of maps cl = (cl_p) on each predication fiber algebra of the predication fiber functor, computing the consequence closure of a valuation under inference rules; generated by closing the predication-fiber-algebra.

components.description: the family (cl_p) indexed by predicates p in the predicate category, each cl_p : A_p -> A_p an endomap of the fiber algebra's underlying knowledge-order lattice

monotone.description: v <=_k v' implies cl_p(v) <=_k cl_p(v') in the knowledge order

natural.description: for every f : q -> p in C, f* . cl_p = cl_q . f* (closure commutes with predicate-category base change)
